propositions: The binding store snapshot commit uses git add -A which stages unwanted files like .bridge_state/last-pass.json, causing HEAD to advance on idempotent passes and breaking idempotency tests.
A new pathspec-capable commit_tickets_branch seam must be extracted from commit_and_push_tickets_branch to allow selective file staging without push.
The seam must support optional paths parameter (None for git add -A, or a sequence for scoped git status/add -- <paths> staging) and strict mode for proper error handling.
_commit_binding_store_snapshot must route through the locked commit seam with paths restricted to the 5 allowed .bridge_state files and strict=True to preserve fail-open behavior.
Per-file idempotency is preserved via pathspec-scoped git status --porcelain that only stages individually-reported-dirty files from the allowed set.
The raw-git-ok marker and reason for it are eliminated by moving the binding store snapshot commit into the shared locked transaction seam.
